cases.title: Which Monday?

claims.gloss: The arrival at Quba is dated the 12th of Rabīʿ al-awwal, a Monday.
The Prophet's arrival at Madinah is dated to twelve nights gone of Rabīʿ al-Awwal.

cases.rule: A month begins the first evening the Moon is 30 hours past conjunction and 8 degrees above the horizon at sunset: a simple stand-in for sighting the crescent.

questions.q: From Qubāʾ, which way does Madinah lie?
questions.why: 4 km at a bearing of 349°, computed from the gazetteer points.

questions.q: The text names 22 places from Makkah to Qubāʾ. How many can be placed on a map here?
questions.why: 4 have a gazetteer point; 7 are recorded as claims so far.

questions.q: On which weekday does the text place it?
questions.why: "twelve nights gone of Rabīʿ al-Awwal, on a Monday, when the forenoon heat grew strong and the sun had nearly reached its height" (vol. 1, p. 492).

questions.q: Under the simple crescent rule, did any computed lunation give that weekday?
questions.why: before: Thursday 26 August 622; tabular: Friday 24 September 622; after: Sunday 24 October 622.
